svg.title: Scene 2: Phone Zoom + Comment Scroll
svg.desc: A reclining person uses a handheld phone; comments then scroll inside a separate centered phone frame before the highlighted terms gather into a full-screen hashtag cloud.
svg.metadata: Scene 2 | Phone Zoom + Comment Scroll | Editable vector storyboard. Existing Storyset art is embedded as SVG; all other visuals are hand-edited vector shapes, not generated images.

text.tspan: Pacar gue tiap ada masalah suka ngilang.
Gue chat malam, pagi baru dibales
Padahal dia yang salah, malah marah
Kak, dia murung terus akhir-akhir ini.
